seed_search: seeds are tried upward from 20261119; the first one whose every rung lands within 5 tools of its target adds at least one near-twin and one unrelated server, and whose top rung holds a near-twin of every core server that has one, is used (2 rejected)
naming_rule: each server is named after its upstream package or folder with the mcp and server words dropped (github-mcp-server is github, mcp-grafana is grafana, cloudwatch-mcp-server is cloudwatch); the one clash, two Slack servers, keeps slack for korotovsky/slack-mcp-server and names the archived reference server, which runs on a bot token, slack-bot
prefix_rule: a harness sees each tool as <server>__<tool> (Claude Code adds mcp__ in front); names are unique per rung under that rule
rung_rule: core first; then distractor servers are taken whole in distractor_order, and a server is added to a rung when it keeps the rung at or under target + 5; a server that would overshoot waits for the next rung; a rung closes once it reaches target - 5
order_rule: twins and unrelated servers are each shuffled with mulberry32(seed), then interleaved so both kinds are spread evenly through the order
